title: Tennis: Alex Eala survives tough Ruzic challenge to make Hong Kong Open semis
summary: Alex Eala overcame a tough challenge from Croatian Antonia Ruzic, to advance to the semifinals of the Hong Kong Tennis Open, 7-6(7), 7-5, on Friday evening.
